# Consumer-price basket (`price-basket` v1)

Headline and core inflation and each basket component's weight, inflation and contribution.

**Group:** Economics · **Mnemonic:** `CPIB` · **Identifiers:** `CPIB-…` in `basketId`

Open one with `CPIB <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: price-basket
version: 1
description: "Headline and core inflation and each basket component's weight, inflation and contribution."
match: { kind: price-basket, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Economics · Consumer-price basket, id: $.basketId }
strip:
  - { label: Economy, bind: $.economyName }
  - { label: Headline, bind: $.headline, fmt: pct2, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Core, bind: $.core, fmt: pct2 }
  - { label: Services, bind: $.services, fmt: pct2 }
  - { label: Goods, bind: $.goods, fmt: pct2 }
panels:
  - id: components
    kind: table
    title: Components
    key: F2
    rows: $.components
    columns:
      - { label: Component, bind: "@.component" }
      - { label: Weight, bind: "@.weight", fmt: pct0 }
      - { label: Inflation (y/y), bind: "@.inflation", fmt: pct2, tone: sign }
      - { label: Contribution (pp), bind: "@.contribution", fmt: price2, tone: sign, total: true }
  - id: contributions
    kind: hbar
    title: Contribution to headline (pp)
    area: right
    rows: $.components
    label: component
    value: contribution
    fmt: price2
    tone: sign
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.economy, 'economy')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
